name: Silent Bonds
source:
Ten years ago, a young Luke was abandoned by Neal, the very man who took him in years ago. Now, Neal, who was once the leader of the most powerful gang in District A, is Luke’s prisoner. Years of hatred made them go for each others’ throats the moment they reunited— but Luke was not able to be cruel to Neal. Was it because of Neal’s willingness to compromise, or a secret love that never faded away? Their relationship gets more complicated, with no clear ending to their story.

[From [url=https://thairdev.itch.io/silent-bonds]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
十年前，年轻的卢克被尼尔抛弃，而尼尔正是多年前收留他的人。现在，曾经是A区最强大帮派头目的尼尔，却成了卢克的阶下囚。多年的仇恨让他们重逢时就互相掐架——但卢克无法对尼尔残忍。是因为尼尔愿意妥协，还是因为永不褪色的暗恋？他们的关系变得更加复杂，他们的故事也没有明确的结局。

[来自[url=https://thairdev.itch.io/silent-bonds]itch.io[/url]]
